mapper.select: WITH scope_projects AS () SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scope_projects) AS projectCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scope_projects WHERE status = 'ACTIVE') AS activeProjectCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM knowledge_assets a WHERE a.project_id IN (SELECT id FROM scope_projects)) AS assetCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM knowledge_assets a WHERE a.project_id IN (SELECT id FROM scope_projects) AND a.index_status IN ('SUCCESS', 'INDEXED')) AS indexedAssetCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM knowledge_assets a WHERE a.project_id IN (SELECT id FROM scope_projects) AND a.index_status = 'FAILED') AS failedAssetCount, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(a.chunk_count), 0) FROM knowledge_assets a WHERE a.project_id IN (SELECT id FROM scope_projects)) AS chunkCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM research_runs r WHERE r.project_id IN (SELECT id FROM scope_projects)) AS runCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM research_runs r WHERE r.project_id IN (SELECT id FROM scope_projects) AND r.status IN ('QUEUED', 'PENDING')) AS queuedRunCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM research_runs r WHERE r.project_id IN (SELECT id FROM scope_projects) AND r.status IN ('RUNNING', 'PROCESSING')) AS runningRunCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM research_runs r WHERE r.project_id IN (SELECT id FROM scope_projects) AND r.status IN ('COMPLETED', 'SUCCESS')) AS completedRunCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM research_runs r WHERE r.project_id IN (SELECT id FROM scope_projects) AND r.status = 'FAILED') AS failedRunCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM research_runs r WHERE r.project_id IN (SELECT id FROM scope_projects) AND r.status IN ('CANCELLED', 'CANCELED')) AS cancelledRunCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reports r WHERE r.project_id IN (SELECT id FROM scope_projects)) AS reportCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reports r WHERE r.project_id IN (SELECT id FROM scope_projects) AND r.status IN ('PUBLISHED', 'FINAL', 'COMPLETED')) AS publishedReportCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM action_items i WHERE i.project_id IN (SELECT id FROM scope_projects)) AS actionItemCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM action_items i WHERE i.project_id IN (SELECT id FROM scope_projects) AND i.status NOT IN ('DONE', 'COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED', 'CANCELED')) AS openActionItemCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM action_items i WHERE i.project_id IN (SELECT id FROM scope_projects) AND i.due_at < CURRENT_DATE AND i.status NOT IN ('DONE', 'COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED', 'CANCELED')) AS overdueActionItemCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM evaluation_cases e WHERE e.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND (e.project_id IS NULL OR e.project_id IN (SELECT id FROM scope_projects)) AND e.project_id = #{projectId}) AS evaluationCaseCount, (SELECT AVG(e.recall) FROM evaluation_cases e WHERE e.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND (e.project_id IS NULL OR e.project_id IN (SELECT id FROM scope_projects)) AND e.project_id = #{projectId}) AS avgRecall, (SELECT AVG(e.citation) FROM evaluation_cases e WHERE e.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND (e.project_id IS NULL OR e.project_id IN (SELECT id FROM scope_projects)) AND e.project_id = #{projectId}) AS avgCitation, (SELECT AVG(e.json_score) FROM evaluation_cases e WHERE e.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND (e.project_id IS NULL OR e.project_id IN (SELECT id FROM scope_projects)) AND e.project_id = #{projectId}) AS avgJsonScore, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notifications n WHERE n.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND n.recipient_user_id = #{userId} AND n.read_at IS NULL) AS unreadNotificationCount

WITH scope_projects AS (), days AS ( SELECT (CURRENT_DATE - series.day_offset)::date AS day FROM generate_series(0, #{days} - 1) AS series(day_offset) ), assets_by_day AS ( SELECT a.created_at::date AS day, COUNT(*) AS count FROM knowledge_assets a WHERE a.project_id IN (SELECT id FROM scope_projects) AND a.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - (#{days} - 1) GROUP BY a.created_at::date ), runs_by_day AS ( SELECT r.created_at::date AS day, COUNT(*) AS count FROM research_runs r WHERE r.project_id IN (SELECT id FROM scope_projects) AND r.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - (#{days} - 1) GROUP BY r.created_at::date ), reports_by_day AS ( SELECT r.created_at::date AS day, COUNT(*) AS count FROM reports r WHERE r.project_id IN (SELECT id FROM scope_projects) AND r.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - (#{days} - 1) GROUP BY r.created_at::date ), actions_by_day AS ( SELECT i.created_at::date AS day, COUNT(*) AS count FROM action_items i WHERE i.project_id IN (SELECT id FROM scope_projects) AND i.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - (#{days} - 1) GROUP BY i.created_at::date ), evaluations_by_day AS ( SELECT e.created_at::date AS day, AVG(e.recall) AS recall, AVG(e.citation) AS citation, AVG(e.json_score) AS jsonScore FROM evaluation_cases e WHERE e.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND (e.project_id IS NULL OR e.project_id IN (SELECT id FROM scope_projects)) AND e.project_id = #{projectId} AND e.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - (#{days} - 1) GROUP BY e.created_at::date ) SELECT to_char(days.day, 'MM-DD') AS date, COALESCE(assets_by_day.count, 0) AS assets, COALESCE(runs_by_day.count, 0) AS runs, COALESCE(reports_by_day.count, 0) AS reports, COALESCE(actions_by_day.count, 0) AS actionItems, evaluations_by_day.recall AS recall, evaluations_by_day.citation AS citation, evaluations_by_day.jsonScore AS jsonScore FROM days LEFT JOIN assets_by_day ON assets_by_day.day = days.day LEFT JOIN runs_by_day ON runs_by_day.day = days.day LEFT JOIN reports_by_day ON reports_by_day.day = days.day LEFT JOIN actions_by_day ON actions_by_day.day = days.day LEFT JOIN evaluations_by_day ON evaluations_by_day.day = days.day ORDER BY days.day
WITH scope_projects AS () SELECT r.status AS status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM research_runs r WHERE r.project_id IN (SELECT id FROM scope_projects) GROUP BY r.status ORDER BY count DESC, r.status

WITH scope_projects AS () SELECT a.index_status AS status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM knowledge_assets a WHERE a.project_id IN (SELECT id FROM scope_projects) GROUP BY a.index_status ORDER BY count DESC, a.index_status
WITH scope_projects AS () SELECT i.status AS status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM action_items i WHERE i.project_id IN (SELECT id FROM scope_projects) GROUP BY i.status ORDER BY count DESC, i.status
